measured: the demand scan (twin-world scripts/demand-scan.ts, the products volter.ai names) finds the tunnel in Volter Harness (volter-ai/supercode @ 62620578c014c4c0b1d4c34e1268e4112c9dd331): its remote access, given a stable relay (SUPERCODE_TUNNEL_SERVER_URL or TUNNEL_SERVER_URL), opens a tunnel with @volter/tunnel's client for a loopback port, with TUNNEL_SECRET when set, a stable tunnel id and authRequired false, and shares the tunnel URL's origin. The client (volter-ai/volter-tunnel @ c14b6e3, client/tunnel-client.ts) opens the control WebSocket at <host>/ws?id=<tunnelId>, registers, and answers each request frame from the local server; the public side is whoever opens the shared URL. The relay's own /api/status is called by nothing: it answers the gap.

applications.name: volter-ai/supercode (Volter Harness)
applications.client: @volter/tunnel's createTunnel (the control WebSocket), and whoever opens the tunnel's URL; configuration read at sdk/remote-access/index.mjs:324,343

backend.call: the control WebSocket at <relay>/ws?id=<tunnelId>: register (tunnelId, secret, authRequired false), then each request frame answered with the local server's response

frontend.call: a person opens the shared remote-access URL: every request forwarded to the Harness's local server through the control socket
